pr_title: Add missing flag when encode_variant writes math types with doubles
pr_body:
Fixes #57935

The remote inspector is based on `encode_variant` and `decode_variant` to send and receive data. `decode_variant` uses a flag within the type to know if math types in the data are using doubles, but `encode_variant` is always writing `real_t`, without specifying the flag. So I made it so the flag is set when the instance of Godot writing the data is compiled with doubles.

cc @aaronfranke
pr_comments: I don't know if this is correct. The flag should be set when encoding `Variant::VECTOR2` with a double-precision build of Godot, but what about some of the other cases? We don't want `Variant::VECTOR2I` or `Variant::COLOR` to have this flag set.

> We don't want Variant::VECTOR2I or Variant::COLOR to have this flag set.

True, I wasn't actually sure about that. But when I checked, this flag is actually only used on floating-point math types, not on integer ones.
At the very least, maybe I can add the following to make it explicit?
```cpp
		case Variant::VECTOR2:
		case Variant::VECTOR3:
		case Variant::PACKED_VECTOR2_ARRAY:
		case Variant::PACKED_VECTOR3_ARRAY:
		case Variant::QUATERNION:
		case Variant::PLANE:
		case Variant::TRANSFORM2D:
		case Variant::TRANSFORM3D:
		case Variant::BASIS:
		case Variant::RECT2:
		case Variant::AABB: {

```
Edit: ok you wrote the same suggestion :D

issue_context.title: Remote Inspector doesn't populate certain node types in double precision build
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

master v4.0.alpha.custom_build (f21a62b62)

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

When the engine is built with double precision (float = "64"), certain nodes will stop working with the remote inspector. Selecting these nodes in the remote scene tree will not populate the inspector, nor will the inspector be cleared if it was already populated by another node's properties.

Here is a non-exhaustive list of node types that are affected:
```
Node2D
Node3D
Control
SkeletonIK3D
CanvasLayer
```

Not all node types are affected by the issue. Some continue to work properly with the inspector, such as the base Node class, Timer, and WorldEnvironment.

**Video example**: ![RemoteInspectorDoublePrecisionBug](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/10762433/153482714-269e1bbc-d5b2-4cdd-ac28-de7426f13328.gif)

All node types seem to work fine with the remote inspector when the engine is built with single precision floats.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Build the engine with the build option `float = "64"`
2. Create a new project.
3. Add any of the affected node types to the scene tree.
4. Play the scene and try to select any of the affected nodes.

### Minimal reproduction project

[Remote Inspector Double Precision Bug.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/8044058/Remote.Inspector.Double.Precision.Bug.zip)
